What is the parking lot ID of the facility that has the highest revenue potential per available space among locations that either have electric charging with rates below $4.00 OR have no electric charging with capacity above 300, but must also have current occupancy representing less than 80% of capacity?

title: Highway Toll Transaction Records
questions: Among vehicles that used Express routes during peak hours and paid more than $15 in tolls, what is the average distance traveled by those using electronic payment methods (EZPass or Credit) but excluding any vehicle that traveled less than 35 miles or used Cash payment?

For vehicles that either used Local routes during peak hours OR Express routes during non-peak hours (but not both conditions simultaneously), and among those that paid between $10-$18 in tolls, what is the total toll amount collected from vehicles using non-Cash payment methods that traveled more than 20 miles?

title: Daily Flight Operations Manifest
questions: Among flights operated by airlines that have at least one Boeing 777 flight with zero delays, what is the total passenger count for flights that either: (1) originate from airports with 3-letter codes starting with 'D' and have delays greater than 10 minutes, OR (2) are Boeing 737 flights with passenger counts below 140 but exclude any flights to destinations starting with 'L'?

For aircraft types that appear in both on-time flights (0 delay) and delayed flights (>0 delay), calculate the average passenger count difference between delayed and on-time flights of the same aircraft type, then identify which aircraft type has the smallest such difference, considering only types with at least 3 flights total?

title: Railway Ticket Purchase Records
questions: Among passengers who either booked Business class tickets OR have loyalty cards (but not both conditions simultaneously), and whose routes involve NYC as either origin or destination, what is the average ticket price for those whose booking dates fall in the second half of January 2024, excluding any passenger whose ticket price is exactly the median price of all Business class tickets in the dataset?

title: Real-time Traffic Condition Data
questions: Among routes that are either in peak hours with medium congestion OR have active incidents but speeds above 25 mph, calculate the average travel time for those routes where the speed is below the median speed of all qualifying routes, but exclude any route where both peak hours is 'Yes' AND congestion is 'High'.

For routes with no active incidents, group them by congestion level, then for each group calculate the ratio of peak-hour routes to non-peak-hour routes. Which congestion level has the highest such ratio, but only considering groups where the average speed exceeds 40 mph AND the total travel time for all routes in that group is less than 50 minutes?

Identify routes where either (speed > 35 AND travel time < 20) OR (congestion is 'Low' AND peak hours is 'No'), then among these, find routes where the speed-to-travel-time ratio is above the 75th percentile of all qualifying routes, but exclude routes with active incidents. What is the total count of such routes that also have congestion level not equal to 'High'?

title: Ride-hailing Platform Order Data
questions: Among orders where the driver rating is above 4.0 AND it's either a Premium customer during peak hours OR a Standard customer with trip distance exceeding 15 miles, what is the average fare amount for those orders that also have a fare-to-distance ratio greater than 2.5?

For orders that meet ALL of the following criteria: (driver rating between 3.5-4.5 AND NOT during peak hours) OR (Premium customer with distance less than 15 miles AND during peak hours), how many such orders have a fare amount that ranks in the top 30% when compared to orders of the same customer type?

If we exclude orders where driver rating is below 3.5 OR fare amount is below $20, then among the remaining orders, what is the total fare amount for Premium customers during peak hours whose trip distance is either less than 10 miles OR greater than 18 miles, but only if their driver rating exceeds the average rating of all Standard customers in the filtered dataset?

title: Traffic Violation Penalty Records
questions: Among drivers aged 25-40 who have insurance, what is the average fine amount for those with either DUI violations OR (Speeding violations with more than 2 prior violations), but excluding any driver whose fine amount is exactly divisible by 50?

For drivers without insurance who are either under 30 OR have more than 2 prior violations, calculate the total fine amount, then determine how many insured drivers aged 35+ with Reckless or DUI violations have individual fines that exceed this calculated average fine per uninsured driver?

Among violation types that appear at least 3 times in the dataset, identify which type has the highest ratio of (average fine for drivers with insurance and 0-1 prior violations) to (average fine for drivers without insurance and 2+ prior violations), considering only drivers aged 20-45?
